evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs real scripts that exist in site/package.json (`npm ci`, `npm test` with pretest, `npm run build` = prepare-data + svelte-check + vite build, `npm run sample-bullets`) on `pull_request`, then checks the working tree is clean; site/package-lock.json exists and the generated files are gitignored (site/.gitignore). Permissions are minimal: `contents: read` at the top, and `pages: write`/`id-token: write` only on the deploy job (pages.yml:248-250). Only `github.token` is used, there is no `pull_request_target`, and pr-title.yml passes the title through env. But no action is pinned to a commit SHA: `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4`, `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3` and `actions/deploy-pages@v4` (step1.patch lines 144, 146, 239, 256, 328, 352). pages.yml also has a `workflow_dispatch` trigger with no branch guard, so any branch can be dispatched; it relies on the github-pages environment rule that RELEASING.md mentions. Nothing was run, pushed or published, and step 1 touched no app code, tests or data.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch 517-655) covers requirements (.node-version 22), install (`cd site && npm ci`), develop (`npm run dev`), other scripts (prepare-data, sample-bullets, preview), test, build, `PAGES_BASE` (vite.config.ts:11 reads it), CI/CD, data contribution (formatting, keys, sources, the generated sample bullets, the pinned catalogue sizes) and the MIT license. Every command it shows exists in site/package.json, and the linked files (LICENSE, THIRD-PARTY.md, ISSUE_TEMPLATE forms, data/bullets/README.md) exist.
evidence.s1_release: One consistent strategy. The version lives in site/package.json (0.1.0), mirrored by `npm version --no-git-tag-version`. Releases come from a release PR plus a `vX.Y.Z` tag, and release.yml checks that the tag equals the package version and is on main, then extracts the notes with changelog-section.sh. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and SemVer, with a heading format and an [Unreleased] flow. RELEASING.md maps SemVer onto data. Dependabot covers npm (grouped) and actions, with `chore`/`ci` prefixes that match the convention. CONTRIBUTING.md states Conventional Commits with a type table, and pr-title.yml enforces it. All 7 commits in commits.txt follow it (ci:, ci(deps):, ci(release):, docs:, feat(site):, fix(site):).
evidence.s2_requirements: Met: the route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` with parse/href and reload-safe hash routing (router.ts:34-45). One SVG with role=img, aria-label `Profiles of {a} and {b}`, and one `<path>` per outline (Compare.svelte 706-715). caseOuterProfile overlaid in one viewport with head faces at z=0. Table caption `Dimensions ({unit})`, headers Symbol / A name / B name / Difference, symbols from FIELD_LABELS, B−A. Only the `cartridge` part is read, FIELD_UNITS entries and *Tol fields are excluded, imperial values use displayNumber. The `Compare with` select and `Compare` button are on the detail page (CompareWith.svelte), German strings are given, shot cartridges are skipped. Partly met: metric differences are written with `displayNumber(diff,'mm')` (toPrecision(12)), not with formatValue as the spec's 'written the same way … no rounding' asks. The agent did this on purpose (compare.ts:430-432) to drop binary noise (e min shows `-0.46` instead of formatValue's `-0.45999999999999996`).
evidence.s2_correctness: For 308 Win. / 300 Win. Mag., dimensionsOf yields the shared mm fields (E, E1, R, R1, eMin, f, H1, H2, S, r1Min, r2, L1–L6, Fe, P1, P2, G1, L3PlusG) and correctly drops beta/delta/alpha, the pressures and the Tol fields. Viewport.xy maps z=0 to the same x for both profiles, and a shared scale and rMax give one common axis (geom/svg.ts:73-76). Imperial conversion is displayNumber(v,'in') as specified. Records that cannot be drawn (shotshell, or a missing R1) get a note instead of the SVG. The only deviation is the 12-significant-digit rounding of metric differences described above.
evidence.s2_fit: Reuses lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, toleranceFor, formatValue), lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), site units/i18n/router/data, PageHeader, and the shadcn Button/Label/NativeSelect. It follows the lazy-chunk pattern in App.svelte, the metadata map, the `data-ui` + `@layer legacy` styling, and a framework-free site/src/lib/compare.ts with a colocated test. Minor: the table CSS is copied from GroupTable.svelte rather than shared, and outerProfileOf adds its own try/catch around adaptMetallic. The footprint is small: App, router, metadata, SiteNavigation, i18n, Cartridge (one line plus CSS).
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts tests dimensionsOf (excludes tolerances, FIELD_UNITS fields and the chamber, skips repeating groups, dedupes across groups, holds across all records), compareRows (B−A, concrete 308/300 values), metric and imperial formatting against formatValue and displayNumber, and the overlay geometry (one scale, a shared head-face x, a common axis, within the box). router.test.ts adds route and malformed-hash cases. Both run under the existing vitest include. Gaps: nothing tests the Svelte view or CompareWith (accessible names, headers, select/button), though the repo has no component-test setup. Some assertions are weak: `'S '` with a trailing space is checked as absent, and one assertion pins float noise `71.12 - 51.18 === 19.940000000000005`.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: compareRows now returns the union of both records' dimensions with null for a missing side, keeps the order of both records' detail pages, and renders null as an empty cell and an empty Difference (step3.patch 133-167, 238-240). New tests cover `delta L` (a only) and `R3` (b only) on the named pair. Style: `class="n"` and a `th.n, td.n {text-align:right}` rule were added to the three columns and their headers. But step 2's CSS already set `th, td {text-align:right}` with only the first column left-aligned (Compare.svelte:161,164-165), so the rule is redundant, and the agent did not notice or report that the comment's premise was already met. Related copy (lede, differenceNote, noRows in EN/DE) was updated to match the new behaviour, which is justified. There are no regressions.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 added a `### Added` line under `## [Unreleased]`, and step 3 amended that unreleased entry, which is correct for an unreleased feature in Keep a Changelog. The version was left at 0.1.0, as RELEASING.md requires ('main always carries the version of the latest release, except inside a release pull request'). Commits `feat(site): …` and `fix(site): …` follow the convention and are under 100 characters. Nothing indicates the CI checks would fail: the types are consistent, there are no boundary violations, and no generated files are tracked.

unmet_requirements: Step 1: GitHub Actions are pinned to major tags (@v4/@v3), not full commit SHAs
Step 1 (minor): pages.yml's workflow_dispatch has no main-only guard in the workflow itself
Step 2 (partial): metric differences are written via displayNumber (12-significant-digit rounding), not formatValue as 'written the same way … no rounding' asks
strengths: A complete, internally consistent release setup: version in site/package.json, a tag-triggered release workflow that checks the version, the tag's ancestry and a dated CHANGELOG section, Keep a Changelog, Dependabot with prefixes that match the convention, Conventional Commits that are enforced and followed by every commit

The compare view reuses lib/core, lib/geom and lib/shapes2d instead of re-deriving anything: one shared Viewport aligns the head faces and the scale, and the table rules come from FIELD_UNITS, FIELD_LABELS, orderedFields and toleranceFor

The step 3 bug fix gives a correct union of both records' dimensions, keeps both pages' reading order, leaves empty cells and differences where a side is missing, and tests the named delta L / R3 case
issues: None of the workflow actions is pinned to a full commit SHA (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, upload-pages-artifact@v3, deploy-pages@v4)
Metric differences are rounded to 12 significant digits by displayNumber instead of being written with formatValue as the spec says, a deliberate but undeclared deviation from 'no rounding'

The step 3 alignment fix adds a redundant rule (the step 2 CSS already right-aligned those columns), and no tests cover the Svelte view or the Compare-with control (accessible names, headers, navigation)
review.verdict: This is solid, well-integrated work: the repository setup is thorough and consistent, and the compare view reuses the existing geometry and field modules correctly, with good library-level tests and a clean step 3 fix. It falls short of merge-as-is mainly because the workflow actions are not SHA-pinned, and to a lesser degree because metric differences are rounded and the view itself is untested.
